# caputchin_team (Resource)

A Caputchin team — the tenant boundary that owns site keys. Only shared teams are creatable; personal teams are auto-created per account and cannot be managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "caputchin_team" "marketing" {
  name = "marketing"
}

output "marketing_team_id" {
  value = caputchin_team.marketing.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable team name. Modifiable in place.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Owning account identifier.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
- `id` (String) Server-issued team identifier.
- `kind` (String) Team kind. Always `shared` for resources managed by this provider.
- `tier` (String) Plan tier inherited from the owning account. Read-only.
